title: DevX Ops Playbook and Initiative Synchronization for SDKs, Docs, Quickstarts
creator: Anya Patel
description:
Objective: Create an operational playbook and synchronization cadence that maps the Developer Experience (SDKs, docs, quickstarts) initiative to company OKRs, cycle roadmaps, and measurable outcomes. The playbook will standardize how PM, Eng, and Design coordinate release milestones, triage regressions, and measure adoption across hosted/deployed environments.

Scope:
- Standardize a quarterly initiative template (objectives, key results, success metrics, rollout checklist).
- Define a 6-step release runbook for SDK releases and quickstart updates (dev -> canary -> GA).
- Create a cross-team cadence: weekly sync (working), bi-weekly leadership review, and end-of-cycle retro + metrics review.
- Build an OKR mapping sheet that ties Initiative-level KRs to platform-level metrics (latency, error rates, active SDK developers, quickstart completion rate).
- Provide an automated dashboard spec for tracking in the Console (tokens saved, TTFU, docs search CTR).

Why this matters: We frequently push SDK/quickstart changes without consistent rollout controls or aligned success metrics. That leads to mismatched expectations across customer success, growth, and platform teams. A playbook reduces release risk, clarifies ownership, and creates repeatable signals for investment decisions.

Planned milestones:
1) Playbook draft & template (2/28)
2) Metrics spec & dashboard mocks (3/10)
3) Cross-team review and approval (3/19)
4) Pilot SDK release using playbook (3/31)
5) Dashboard live and first retro (4/15)

Out-of-scope: Full automation of rollout (that will be subsequent project with Eng).

Primary success metrics (mapped to OKRs):
- Increase SDK Monthly Active Developers (MAD) by +15% QoQ (OKR: Developer Adoption).
- Reduce average time-to-first-success (TTFS) for quickstarts from 18m -> 10m.
- Docs task completion rate (users who reach a working example) +20% in two cycles.
- Reduce rollback rate on SDK releases from 5% -> <2%.

Stakeholders: PM (Anya Patel), Platform Eng (Marcus Liu), DX Design (Sofia Gomez), Developer Advocacy (Ethan Park), Customer Success (Leah O'Connor).
acceptance_criteria: A playbook document exists in Confluence with template and checklists
Metrics spec CSV and dashboard mock are reviewed by Eng and DX Design
Pilot SDK release follows the runbook with release notes and a postmortem
Console dashboard displays the tracked KR metrics for the initiative
Leadership sign-off recorded in the initiative doc
